title: Privacy Watchdog Opens Investigation Into Smart Glasses Software
subtitle: Authorities take action as concerns grow over secret recording technology

summary.en: The Australian privacy regulator has started an investigation into the company behind the software used in controversial smart glasses. This follows public anger over devices that can record video without people knowing. Retailers have removed the products from sale while the government considers new laws. The investigation focuses on a China-based software maker that did not answer official questions. Experts warn that current privacy laws are struggling to keep up with new wearable technology.
summary.zh: 澳洲隱私監管機構已針對爭議性智慧眼鏡所使用的軟體公司展開調查。此舉源於大眾對這些裝置能在未經許可下錄影感到憤怒。在政府研議新法之際，零售商已將產品下架。調查重點在於一家未回覆官方詢問的中國軟體製造商。專家警告，現行隱私法規難以跟上新興穿戴式技術的發展。

paragraphs.en: The Australian privacy regulator has officially launched an investigation into a China-based software company. This move comes after growing public anger regarding the use of affordable smart glasses that can secretly record high-definition video. These devices, which were recently sold at popular retailers like Kmart, have been nicknamed “pervert glasses” by some members of the public due to fears that people are being filmed without their permission.
paragraphs.zh: 澳洲隱私監管機構已正式對一家總部位於中國的軟體公司展開調查。此舉源於大眾對於市面上平價智慧眼鏡能秘密錄製高畫質影片一事日益不滿。這些裝置近期在凱馬特 (Kmart) 等熱門零售商販售，由於民眾擔心遭到未經許可的拍攝，這些眼鏡被部分大眾戲稱為「變態眼鏡」。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian Technology, the Australian privacy commissioner, Carly Kind, decided to open the investigation after the software maker, Shenzhen Qingcheng, failed to respond to official questions. The HeyCyan app, which is used in these glasses, has been a central point of concern. The regulator is also looking at information from third-party experts who analyzed the technology and the company’s privacy policies. While other companies were contacted as part of this process, the commissioner noted that only Shenzhen Qingcheng is currently under formal investigation.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報科技版》(The Guardian Technology) 報導，澳洲隱私專員卡莉·金德 (Carly Kind) 在該軟體製造商深圳清城未能回覆官方詢問後，決定啟動調查。這些眼鏡所使用的「HeyCyan」應用程式是核心疑慮所在。監管機構也正在審視第三方專家分析該技術及公司隱私政策後所提供的資訊。儘管過程中也聯繫了其他公司，但專員指出，目前僅有深圳清城正接受正式調查。

paragraphs.en: This development follows a period of intense public debate. In August, reports surfaced that Kmart had sold out of its own brand of these smart glasses. Since then, more than 55,000 people have signed a petition organized by GetUp, calling for strict rules on how these devices are used. Local councils across Australia have also started looking into banning the glasses in public areas, such as swimming pools, to protect the privacy of citizens. In response to the growing pressure, Kmart removed the glasses from its website earlier this week.
paragraphs.zh: 此一進展發生在一段激烈的公眾辯論之後。八月時，有報導指出凱馬特自有品牌的智慧眼鏡已銷售一空。自那時起，已有超過五萬五千人連署由「GetUp」組織發起的請願，呼籲針對這些裝置的使用方式制定嚴格規範。澳洲各地的市政議會也開始研議在游泳池等公共區域禁止使用此類眼鏡，以保障公民隱私。面對日益高漲的壓力，凱馬特已於本週稍早將該眼鏡從官網下架。

paragraphs.en: One of the biggest challenges for officials is that current privacy laws were designed for companies, not for individuals. Commissioner Kind explained that the current Privacy Act does not always apply to people who use these devices to record others in public. Furthermore, retailers or manufacturers may not have any legal obligations if they are not the ones collecting personal information. This makes it difficult for the government to control how the technology is used by everyday people in their daily lives.
paragraphs.zh: 官員面臨的最大挑戰之一，在於現行的隱私法規是為企業而非個人所設計。金德專員解釋，現行的《隱私法》並不總是適用於在公共場合使用這些裝置錄製他人的個人。此外，若零售商或製造商並非蒐集個人資訊的當事人，他們可能不具備任何法律義務。這使得政府難以控管一般民眾在日常生活中如何使用這項技術。

paragraphs.en: To address these gaps, the government is considering updates to the privacy law. Commissioner Kind stated that a new “fair and reasonable” test could replace the current rules. This change would require companies to consider several factors, such as whether a person had a real choice about their information being collected. It would also place a higher priority on the best interests of children. Kind expressed hope that these reforms would provide comfort to the public and set a higher standard for what information smart glasses are allowed to gather.
paragraphs.zh: 為了彌補這些漏洞，政府正考慮更新隱私法。金德專員表示，一項新的「公平且合理」測試可能會取代現行規則。這項變革將要求企業考量多項因素，例如當事人對於其資訊是否被蒐集是否擁有真正的選擇權。這也將把兒童的最佳利益置於更高的優先順序。金德表示，希望這些改革能讓大眾感到安心，並為智慧眼鏡獲准蒐集的資訊內容設立更高的標準。

paragraphs.en: Researchers at the University of Sydney have also highlighted the risks posed by this technology. Their analysis of hundreds of videos posted on social media shows a clear trend toward “discreet, point-of-view recording.” This means that people are increasingly using these glasses to record others in a way that is very difficult for bystanders to notice. As these devices become smaller and more common, experts warn that the potential for secret recording will only increase.
paragraphs.zh: 雪梨大學 (University of Sydney) 的研究人員也強調了這項技術所帶來的風險。他們對社群媒體上數百支影片的分析顯示，有一股明顯的「隱蔽式第一人稱視角錄影」趨勢。這意味著人們越來越常使用這些眼鏡在旁人難以察覺的情況下錄製他人。隨著這些裝置變得更小且更普及，專家警告，秘密錄影的可能性只會持續增加。

paragraphs.en: This issue is not limited to Australia. As reported by earlier updates, other countries are also taking action. For example, Norway is currently working on new laws to temporarily ban AI smart glasses in many public spaces. The goal in both countries is to ensure that personal privacy is protected in an age where wearable cameras are becoming cheap and easy to buy.
paragraphs.zh: 此議題並非僅限於澳洲。正如稍早的更新報導，其他國家也正採取行動。例如，挪威目前正致力於制定新法，以在許多公共空間暫時禁止人工智慧智慧眼鏡。兩國的目標皆是確保在穿戴式攝影機變得便宜且易於取得的時代，個人隱私能受到保障。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the privacy commissioner believes that these legal reforms are becoming necessary. As technology continues to evolve, we are seeing a new generation of wearable devices, ranging from personal assistant gadgets to recording badges. The investigation into the software behind the HeyCyan app is just the first step in a much larger effort to update the rules for the digital age. For now, the focus remains on ensuring that companies are held responsible for the data their software collects, while the government works to find a balance between new technology and the right to privacy.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，隱私專員認為這些法律改革已變得刻不容緩。隨著技術持續演進，我們正目睹新一代穿戴式裝置的出現，範圍涵蓋個人助理小工具到錄影徽章。針對 HeyCyan 應用程式背後軟體的調查，僅是為數位時代更新規則這項龐大工程的第一步。目前，焦點仍放在確保企業須為其軟體所蒐集的數據負起責任，同時政府也正努力在創新技術與隱私權之間尋求平衡。

keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（賣出），這裡指商品全部賣光。文中：In August, reports surfaced that Kmart had sold out of its own brand of these smart glasses.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To deal with or try to solve a problem or issue.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（地址），這裡作動詞指處理問題。文中：To address these gaps, the government is considering updates to the privacy law.

quiz.question: What is the primary reason the Australian privacy commissioner launched a formal investigation into Shenzhen Qingcheng?

options.A: The company sold smart glasses directly to customers at Kmart.
options.B: The company failed to provide answers to official inquiries.
options.C: The company's smart glasses were banned by local councils.
options.D: The company refused to update its privacy policies for the app.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，澳洲隱私專員 Carly Kind 決定展開調查的原因是該軟體製造商 Shenzhen Qingcheng 未能回應官方的詢問。選項 A 錯誤，因為製造商與零售商（Kmart）不同；選項 C 錯誤，地方議會的行動是公眾壓力下的反應，而非調查啟動的原因；選項 D 錯誤，文中並未提到該公司拒絕更新政策，而是提到該公司未回應問題。

quiz.question: Based on the article, why is it currently difficult for the Australian government to stop individuals from using smart glasses to record others secretly?

options.A: Because the HeyCyan app is encrypted and cannot be monitored by the government.
options.B: Because most people are unaware that these glasses can record high-definition video.
options.C: Because existing laws primarily regulate corporate behavior rather than private individual actions.
options.D: Because the government has not yet received enough public complaints to justify new laws.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第四段，專員 Kind 解釋目前的隱私法規是為了企業設計的，不一定適用於在公共場合使用裝置記錄他人的個人，這使得政府難以控管個人行為。選項 A 文中未提及；選項 B 與文章提到的公眾憤怒與擔憂相反；選項 D 錯誤，因為文中提到已有超過 55,000 人簽署請願書，公眾壓力已經很大。

quiz.question: In the sixth paragraph, what does the word 'discreet' mean in the context of 'discreet, point-of-view recording'?

options.A: Careful and unobtrusive to avoid being noticed.
options.B: Aggressive and loud to intimidate bystanders.
options.D: Legal and permitted by local councils.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文中提到這種錄影方式讓旁觀者很難察覺（difficult for bystanders to notice），因此 'discreet' 在此處意指「謹慎、不顯眼、不易被察覺」。選項 B 與文意相反；選項 C 雖然這些裝置科技先進，但 'discreet' 並非指技術層面；選項 D 錯誤，這種行為正是目前引發爭議且可能被禁止的行為。

quiz.question: What is the central message of the article regarding the use of smart glasses?

options.A: Kmart is solely responsible for the privacy issues caused by the smart glasses it sold.
options.B: The Australian government has already successfully banned all wearable cameras in public.
options.C: Technological advancements have outpaced current laws, necessitating legal reforms to protect privacy.
options.D: The HeyCyan app is the only software currently being investigated for privacy violations worldwide.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。全文的核心在於探討科技進步（如智慧眼鏡）帶來的隱私挑戰，以及現行法規的不足，並強調政府正致力於透過法律改革來平衡科技發展與個人隱私權。選項 A 錯誤，零售商只是事件的一部分；選項 B 錯誤，目前僅是「考慮」更新法律，尚未全面禁止；選項 D 錯誤，文中提到挪威也在採取行動，且該調查只是更大規模改革的一環。
